info.name: Create a document signing submission for the authenticated partner and user

params.name: document_type
params.description: The type of document to submit for signing. Valid values: tax_certification

items.docs: Creates a signing submission for the given document type (e.g. a W-8BEN tax certification) for the current entity. The signing link is emailed to the user. Re-posting acts as a resend/re-sign where the document state allows it. The submitted PII pre-fills the form and is forwarded to Passport, never persisted by Frontline.
